problem.title: Maximum Twin Sum of a Linked List
problem.problemStatement: A linked list of even length has twin nodes defined as follows: The first node is the twin of the last node. The second node is the twin of the second-last node. And so on. The twin sum of a pair is the sum of their values. Return the maximum twin sum among all twin pairs.
problem.output: A single integer representing the maximum twin sum.
